name: Fujicco Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujicco Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells traditional Japanese processed food products in Japan. The company offers delicatessen products, including packaged delicatessens, daily delicatessens, soup stocks/broths, and seasonings. It also provides kombu products, such as kombu boiled in soy sauce, salt-dusted dried kombu, thin shaved dried kombu, kombu for Japanese soup, and food for Japanese new year's.
